title: A Nested Doll-velopement
description: A Nested Doll-velopement — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 3. Next, kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5. Finally, return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 3. Next, kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5. Finally, return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Did you know that when you kill a Nesting Doll strain they drop inanimate miniature version of themselves? Really? I thought everyone knew that. Anyway, I am starting to think that their magical powers might actually be stored in the miniatures. Do you think that you could go and get me some samples of these miniatures?

First I need you to Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, which is off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 3. When you have killed the Ice Whisker Nesting Doll they should drop what I am looking for. I also need you to kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, which is off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5. Once you kill them collect the miniature dolls and return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You have the Nested Dolls? Excellent, maybe now I can crack the secrets to their magicaly power! Now, where is my Phisher Prys My First Alchemy Set?

Objectives:

  • Ice Whisker Nested Doll ×1
  • Fire Mutant Nested Doll ×1

Level range: 90–100
